diagnosis.cause: The conductor route is repeatedly regenerated as the clamp moves. componentObstacles included clamp-meter because Leads.floating excludes only multimeter and probeColor, so the noninvasive clamp itself repelled cable routing as it approached. Target jumped between opposite path positions.
diagnosis.classification: Product route-obstacle interaction defect, observed through Windows browser logs and confirmed in source

correction.change: Exclude clamp-meter components from componentObstacles while retaining supply/resistor/other obstacles
correction.actual_source_isolated_test: 4/4 PASS: movement of clamp to four different positions leaves other routing obstacles unchanged
correction.local_node_replay: 27/27 PASS for clamp-meter and instruments tests in prior uploaded source tree patched with same obstacle fix
